about_the_game:
Ghost Keeper merges classic elements from beloved old-school games of the genre with various modern innovations. Allowing you to delve into the ultimate scaring experience. Become the leader of a group of peculiar monsters and experience equally strange adventures set in the climate of 19th-century England.

This free demo offers a glimpse into the full version of Ghost Keeper. As your first mission you must guide Night Blade and William ghosts to free the spirit of the mad scientist, Phineas — and bring him onto your team! Get rid of all mortals in the mansion and remember to not get caught by the Brotherhood!

Your ghostly legion awaits your orders—send them into battle and dominate the living! Each spirit packs unique firepower that can turn the tide in an instant. Master their abilities, coordinate the assault, and unleash hell on anyone foolish enough to challenge your reign!

The Brotherhood members never rests, and neither can you. Taking them down means risking everything—but the spoils of victory make it worthwhile. Fight hard, fight smart, because there can be only one winner.

A true Ghost Keeper seizes opportunities and makes fateful decisions. Test your wits and intelligence: can you plan, manage, and scare effectively to achieve your goals?

Enjoy the beautiful 19th-century English scenery and engaging, grotesque humor. Delve into the detailed visuals and experience the terrifying fun of scaring.

  • Take control of your ghosts, plan and use their unique abilities to defeat your enemies!

  • Fight malicious Brotherhood, show the world who is the ultimate keeper of fearful creatures.

  • Exploit varied strategies, there is never only one path to victory - the way you lead is entirely up to you.

  • Enjoy a truly grotesque approach, witness a host of bizarre situations narrated by the peculiar, malicious narrator.

  • Marvel at the Victorian era setting, gorgeous mansion, style and atmosphere that’ll captivate you on each subsequent level.

  • An ultimate scaring experience, remember that only through fear, you can claim a true power!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or up
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or up
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600/Intel Core i5 8400 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5500/NVIDIA GTX 1650 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Become a Ghost Keeper and lead your fearsome minions against the living. Use diverse scare tactics and control your creatures to achieve your goals! Oh, and don’t let the Brotherhood catch you! The ultimate scaring experience begins…
